---

This release improves translation support across the app's templates.

- **Added translation markup to nearly 60 templates that were previously missing it**,
  so more of the built-in UI can be translated out of the box.
  This covers the account, subscription, e-commerce, team, chat, and example app pages,
  as well as various shared components (navigation, pagination, landing page sections, and error pages).
- Updated the subscription details page to use `blocktranslate` for text containing dates,
  so those sentences can be translated as complete phrases.
